d3d11screencapturesrc.name: The name of the object
d3d11screencapturesrc.blocksize: Size in bytes to read per buffer (-1 = default)
d3d11screencapturesrc.num-buffers: Number of buffers to output before sending EOS (-1 = unlimited)
d3d11screencapturesrc.do-timestamp: Apply current stream time to buffers
d3d11screencapturesrc.automatic-eos: Automatically EOS when the segment is done
d3d11screencapturesrc.monitor-index: Zero-based index for monitor to capture (-1 = primary monitor)
d3d11screencapturesrc.monitor-handle: A HMONITOR handle of monitor to capture
d3d11screencapturesrc.crop-x: Horizontal coordinate of top left corner for the screen capture area
d3d11screencapturesrc.crop-y: Vertical coordinate of top left corner for the screen capture area
d3d11screencapturesrc.crop-width: Width of screen capture area (0 = maximum)
d3d11screencapturesrc.crop-height: Height of screen capture area (0 = maximum)

mfh264enc.name: The name of the object
mfh264enc.min-force-key-unit-interval: Minimum interval between force-keyunit requests in nanoseconds
mfh264enc.vbv-buffer-size: VBV(HRD) Buffer Size in bytes (0 = MFT default)
mfh264enc.max-bitrate: The maximum bitrate applied when rc-mode is "pcvbr" in kbit/sec
mfh264enc.quality-vs-speed: Quality and speed tradeoff, [0, 33]: Low complexity, [34, 66]: Medium complexity, [67, 100]: High complexity
mfh264enc.bframes: The maximum number of consecutive B frames
mfh264enc.gop-size: The number of pictures from one GOP header to the next. Depending on GPU vendor implementation, zero gop-size might produce only one keyframe at the beginning (-1 for automatic)
mfh264enc.threads: The number of worker threads used by a encoder, (0 = MFT default)
mfh264enc.content-type: Indicates the type of video content
mfh264enc.min-qp: The minimum allowed QP applied to all rc-mode
mfh264enc.max-qp: The maximum allowed QP applied to all rc-mode
mfh264enc.d3d11-aware: Whether device can support Direct3D11 interop
